records.evidence: Never edit generated output to prove a theory.
`yarn typecheck`, `yarn lint`, `yarn test`, `yarn build` for broad/contract changes.
Run `yarn db:generate` as a probe; inspect all SQL and snapshot changes.
Import `findWithDecryption`, `findOneWithDecryption`, or `findAndCountWithDecryption` from `@open-mercato/shared/lib/encryption/find`
In module `encryption.ts`, import `ModuleEncryptionMap` from `@open-mercato/shared/modules/encryption`
Seed/update encryption configuration through the supported command; never hand-roll KMS/AES.
Run supported `yarn mercato eject <module>` from app root.
State the required behavior and exact installed module/version.
run `yarn generate`, focused/integration/build tests, and record upstream version for future merges.
Persist credentials/state/logs/mappings through generic integration/data-sync services; do not duplicate host tables.
Test missing provider configuration as `unconfigured`/degraded, not a crash or secret leak.
Run `yarn generate` and `yarn typecheck` so the generated registry proves that exact export shape.
An app-owned `integration.ts` may export singular `integration`/`bundle` definitions or plural `integrations`/`bundles` arrays.
create a separate publishable package/repository with compatible peer/runtime dependencies, public exports, build/prepack, and compiled discovery output
**Data sync:** `DataSyncAdapter`; entity mappings/presets; external IDs; streaming batches/cursors; overlap, progress, cancellation, reconciliation.
**Payment:** installed `GatewayAdapter` plus `registerGatewayAdapter`
**Webhooks:** inbound verification/replay; outbound Standard Webhooks signing; queued deliveries, retries, logs, status.
Health checks and OAuth refresh retries redact credentials and provider details
`search.ts` imports `SearchModuleConfig`
Run `yarn generate`; inspect warnings and the affected module/API/page/entity/event/search/agent registrations.
Run `yarn generate`, focused tests, typecheck, and affected integration flow.
Trace from the public call site to the first broken invariant.
The oracle must fail on the pre-fix code for the intended reason
